registry_info.description: The vending machines (Palle, 2026-11-06): one interface to pick up the prefabs, and another for the tools - a lit cabinet of holographic miniatures, each over the tape line that writes its association; grabbing one collects the item with the tape's config.

vending_machine.name: Vending machine / prefabs or tools, holographic
vending_machine.description: A cabinet with a lit glass front and shelves. Every slot holds a holographic miniature of one inventory item (commons/data/inventory/items.json) over a tape line - rubber_ball = association(config(point)) - and hands over the tape's config (the item's defaults, the term's config). Grabbing a slot collects the item onto the hand's belt and into the hand, as the association plinth does; the miniature goes straight back, a machine never runs out. The glass has no collider. Locked items show dark with their floor. config: kind prefabs|tools, columns, mini, title.
